description: Come join Senators Harrington and Libby, along with Senate Candidate Kenny Cianchette for an evening of music, cocktails, heavy hors d'oeuvres, and a sunset on Long Lake. Gear up with us for the 2024 election season! Tickets are $60 per person, Donations are capped at $475 per perosn. Buy tickets
title: 2024 Sunset Cruise Bash — Matt Harrington for Maine Senate
